successors.name: Nanda Empire
successors.text: 'Panchala was annexed into the Magadha empire during the reign of Mahapadma Nanda in the mid-4th century BCE'

ledger.x: 600 BCE: Panchala enters the map as one of the sixteen Mahajanapadas.
340 BCE: Magadha under Mahapadma Nanda annexes Panchala.

certainty.note: The page bounds the country only by rivers and forest (west of the Gomti, north of the Chambal, the Ganga's source forests); no frontier with Kuru, Surasena or Kosala is given.
